name: EgoTaskQA
description: EgoTaskQA is a benchmark for evaluating understanding of human tasks in egocentric videos through question-answering. It targets action dependencies, intents, goals, and agents' beliefs with questions spanning descriptive, predictive, explanatory, and counterfactual types.
reputation: A relatively recent but well-cited benchmark in egocentric video reasoning, used mainly in research on task understanding and causal/counterfactual question answering.
notes: Focuses on spatial, temporal, and causal understanding of goal-oriented tasks in egocentric videos.
